intro.h2: Refinish first, replace only when you need to
paragraphs: Luxury Refinishing Inc does bathroom refinishing Miramar and South Florida homeowners recommend to their neighbors. Bathroom refinishing is the work reviewers mention most on Google, and one client called the company the best bathtub refinisher in South Florida.

Refinishing lets you keep a sound tub or solid cabinets and change how they look. One family found Reidel on Nextdoor through a neighbor's recommendation. He refinished a huge wall unit, going from dark cherry wood to crisp white, and also did two of their bathrooms. They described him as meticulous, with special attention to the small details. When a room needs more than a new finish, the team also handles kitchen and bathroom remodels.

items.name: Bathtub and bathroom refinishing
items.blurb: The company's most reviewed service. A worn or dated bathtub and bathroom surfaces get a fresh finish without tearing everything out, so you keep the tub that already fits the room. Ask what can be refinished in your bathroom before you plan a full demolition.

items.name: Cabinet refinishing
items.blurb: Solid kitchen and bathroom cabinets refinished in a new color, often bright white, so the room looks updated without buying new boxes. Cabinet refinishing is mentioned by name in Google reviews, and one client said Reidel did a really great job refinishing their cabinets.

image.alt: Kitchen with white raised panel cabinets, glass-front uppers, dark granite island and stainless appliances

items.name: Built-in wall units
items.blurb: Big built-ins can be refinished too. One family's floor-to-ceiling cherry wall unit with a TV opening and display shelves was refinished in white, turning a heavy, dark wall into a bright one that fits the rest of the room.

image.alt: Large built-in wall unit refinished in white with open shelves, crown molding and a TV opening

items.name: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: When a new finish is not enough, the team takes on kitchen and bathroom remodels. One client described an excellent remodeling experience from start to finish, with a professional team, great communication and beautiful results at the end.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with marble-look countertops, full-height backsplash, stainless range and microwave

items.name: Flooring and demolition
items.blurb: Flooring and demolition are part of the remodeling work too, so the same company can clear out an old bathroom or kitchen and lay the new floor. Call to talk through what your room needs and which parts can simply be refinished.

about.text: Luxury Refinishing Inc is a refinishing and remodeling company in Miramar, Florida. Clients name Reidel as the person who does the work, and they describe him as meticulous and careful with small details. The core of the business is what its name says: refinishing bathtubs, bathrooms and cabinets so homeowners can keep what is solid and change how it looks. The company also handles kitchen and bathroom remodeling, flooring and demolition. With a 5.0 rating from 31 Google reviews, many new clients arrive the way one family did, through a neighbor's recommendation.

steps.title: Call or send photos
steps.text: Call (786) 236-4294 or email luxuryrefinishing@gmail.com with photos of the tub, bathroom or cabinets you want refinished or remodeled.

steps.title: Look at the options
steps.text: Talk through what can be refinished and what needs replacing, and agree on color, finish and price before any work starts.

steps.title: Prep and protect
steps.text: The work area is cleaned, repaired where needed and masked off, since careful prep is what makes a new finish last.

steps.title: Refinish or remodel
steps.text: New finish goes on the tub, bathroom surfaces or cabinets, or the remodel work is carried out if your project needs more.

steps.title: Final check
steps.text: Look over the finished surfaces with the team, check the small details, and ask any questions about caring for the new finish.

service_area.h2: Based in Miramar, working across South Florida
service_area.text: Luxury Refinishing Inc is based in Miramar, Florida, and clients describe it as a South Florida bathtub refinisher. Google does not list a public address or a set service area, so the easiest way to check is to call (786) 236-4294 with your town and the project you have in mind. Weekday hours start at 5 AM, which helps if you want to talk before work.

items.a: Bathtubs, bathroom surfaces and cabinets, including large built-in wall units. Bathroom refinishing is the service clients review most often on Google, followed by cabinet refinishing. Send a photo of what you want refinished and the team will tell you whether refinishing is a good fit.

items.q: Do you also do full remodels?
items.a: Yes. Besides refinishing, Luxury Refinishing takes on kitchen and bathroom remodeling, flooring and demolition. One client described an excellent remodeling experience from start to finish, with great communication and beautiful results. Call to talk through which option makes sense for your room.

The company is based in Miramar, Florida, and a client called it the best bathtub refinisher in South Florida. There is no public street address on Google. Call (786) 236-4294 and give your town to confirm the team can reach your home before you book.

Monday to Friday from 5 AM to 6 PM. The business is closed on Saturday and Sunday. The early start means you can usually reach someone before you leave for work. You can also email luxuryrefinishing@gmail.com with photos at any time.

items.q: Can you refinish my dark wood cabinets in white?
items.a: Yes. One family had a huge cherry wood wall unit refinished in white, along with cabinets in two bathrooms, and they said Reidel paid special attention to the small details. Send photos of your cabinets so he can look at their condition and the finish you want.
